# Xenoscapers — Services, Locations, and How to Contact Us

## What We Do

- **Landscaping**
  - Lawns & gardens
  - Turf installation
  - Xeriscaping (low‑maintenance, water‑wise design)

- **Hardscaping**
  - Patios & decking
  - Paver driveways & walkways
  - Retaining walls
  - Outdoor kitchens & fire pits
  - Drainage & grading systems
  - Pools & spas
  - Paver repairs & maintenance

Explore services:
- Landscaping: https://xenoscapers.com/landscaping
- Hardscaping: https://xenoscapers.com/hardscaping
- Xeriscaping: https://xenoscapers.com/landscaping/xeriscaping

## Service Areas

- **Los Angeles**: Hollywood Hills, Beverly Hills, Silver Lake, Santa Monica, Pasadena, and more.
- **Orange County**: Newport Beach, Irvine, Tustin, Mission Viejo, Laguna Niguel, and surrounding areas.

## Recent Project Examples

- **Los Angeles**

  - Beverly Hills Modern Patio — Turf lawn with modern paver patio and seating.
  - Hillside Paver Driveway — Paver driveway with stone stairway.
  - Pasadena Lawn & Garden — Low‑water lawn with native shrubs and trees.

- **Orange County**

  - Redesigned Courtyard — Serenity layout with center fountain.
  - Pool Area & Outdoor Kitchen — Pool area with outdoor kitchen and seating.
  - Mission Viejo Pool Area — Sleek geometric pool, raised spa, and vibrant turf lawn.
